summary: Harrisburg family lawyer and national president of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers in 2013–14; daughter of Joseph F. Cognetti and John's mother's first cousin.
bio:
Maria P. Cognetti is a daughter of Joseph F. Cognetti, the Scranton confectionery broker and Candy Hall of Fame member, and his wife Domenica, and so a first cousin of John's mother, Sharon. She was born in Manhattan. Her firm biography recalls a father who left school after the eighth grade and built a successful company, and a brother who became a lawyer and judge in New York.

She finished law school in 1978, began practising in Pittsburgh, and went on to found the Cognetti Law Group in Harrisburg, a family-law firm she leads as managing partner. A Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, she served as its national president in 2013–14 and received its Fellow of the Year award in 2011, the same year the Pennsylvania Bar Association gave her a Special Achievement Award for her work on the state's Child Custody Act.
